title: Ghanaian Pidgin English
extract: Ghanaian Pidgin English (GhaPE) is a Ghanaian English-lexifier pidgin also known as Pidgin, Broken English, and Kru English. GhaPE is a regional variety of West African Pidgin English spoken in Ghana, predominantly in the southern capital, Accra, and surrounding towns. It has strong influence from Received Pronunciation, as well as Ga and Akan, two languages indigenous to the Greater Accra region.
